viewsWelcome.contents:
Manage GitHub and GitLab Issues and Milestones from a central panel.
[Open Panel](command:remoteProjectManager.openPanel)

remoteProjectManager.repository.description: Fallback repository or project path, e.g. 'owner/repo'. Only used when no workspace folder has a recognized git 'origin' remote; the detected remote always wins.

remoteProjectManager.gitlabHost.description: Hostname of a self-hosted GitLab instance (e.g. 'gitlab.example.com'), used both to auto-detect repositories on that host and to connect to its API. Leave empty to use gitlab.com.

remoteProjectManager.cacheTtlSeconds.description: How long issue/milestone/capability reads are cached before refetching, in seconds. Use the panel's Refresh button to bypass the cache immediately.

remoteProjectManager.autoBranchOnInProgr.description: Automatically create and check out a git branch when an issue assigned to you moves to 'in-progress'. When off, a suggested branch name is shown instead.

remoteProjectManager.branchNamePattern.description: Pattern for auto-created branch names. Placeholders: ${type} (inferred from labels, e.g. fix/feature/docs/issue), ${issue_id} (issue number), ${slug} (sanitized title).

remoteProjectManager.aiContextFile.description: Workspace-relative path 'Export Milestone Context for AI Agents' writes to. Only the extension-managed section (between HTML comment markers) is replaced on re-export; the rest of the file, if any, is left untouched.
